email_body:
Dear Wonka AI team,

I am writing to apply for the AI Adoption Specialist role. With daily hands-on use of generative AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, I have developed strong prompting skills and a practical understanding of how AI can be integrated into everyday workflows. In my freelance work, I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, using structured data and llms.txt to improve visibility. I also create lightweight automations with Python and MCP integrations to streamline repetitive tasks.

I have experience training and supporting others: at Knowledge Experts, I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large organisations like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, and I regularly explain technical concepts to clients. I am comfortable presenting to managers and senior stakeholders, and I enjoy facilitating sessions that make AI tangible and useful.

I am autonomous, well-organised, and thrive in evolving environments. I am fluent in English and eager to bring my mix of AI knowledge, teaching skills, and business analysis to Wonka AI.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Wonka AI team,

I am excited to apply for the AI Adoption Specialist position. Your mission to help organisations make AI work in practice resonates deeply with my own approach: I believe AI is most valuable when it is embedded into daily tasks and supported by hands-on guidance.

In my current freelance work, I use generative AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content creation, and audits. I have developed strong prompt engineering skills and have integrated AI into WordPress and SEO workflows using MCP. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and an llms.txt file to improve AI search visibility, and I regularly run technical audits that raise search-health scores. This hands-on experience has taught me how to identify high-value use cases and implement lightweight AI solutions that deliver measurable results.

I also have a strong teaching and facilitation background. At Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large organisations such as ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, where I helped staff adapt to new tools. I have trained clients on SEO and content management, and I enjoy explaining technical concepts in clear, accessible ways. I am comfortable presenting to managers and senior stakeholders, and I thrive on animating communities and fostering peer learning.

I am autonomous, well-organised, and at ease in evolving environments. I am fluent in English and have a technical background that allows me to quickly grasp new tools and platforms. I am eager to bring my mix of AI expertise, training skills, and business analysis to Wonka AI and to support your teams in adopting AI that truly works.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your AI adoption programme.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
